baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَعْبُدُونَ ... يَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Submissive worship assigns allegiance, while ownership and disposal supply the test: the recipient would need actual command of both adverse and beneficial outcomes. The paired poles make efficacy, not prestige, the criterion.

activation_trace.role: Worship as obedient, humbled submission supplies the allegiance being questioned.
Ownership with power of disposal supplies the criterion of real outcome control.
Loss, injury, and bad condition supply the adverse pole of the capacity test.
Benefit and assistance toward good supply the favorable pole of the capacity test.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely rejects worship of another object.
changed_reading.after: The ayah cross-examines allegiance by demanding evidence of sovereign disposal over the full outcome range, harm and benefit.

baseline_models.mechanism: The alternative is spatially and hierarchically short of the goal: other than God, nearer or lower than the endpoint. The path image within worship makes submission a route smoothed toward a deficient stopping place.

activation_trace.role: Nearness that remains below or short of the goal supplies the deficient-intermediary geometry.
Otherness and lower rank identify the selected recipient as a substitute beneath the endpoint.
Taming and leveling a traveled road supplies the exploratory image of submission creating a route.

changed_reading.before: The phrase simply means worshiping something besides God.
changed_reading.after: It also pictures devotion stopping at a near, lower intermediary and repeatedly smoothing a route that cannot reach the governing source.

baseline_models.mechanism: An uttered interrogation closes with hearing and knowing. The answer and profession are audible, while their truth, intention, and concealed reality remain known; the power test is therefore also an audit of the respondent.

activation_trace.role: Voiced speech supplies the public question and any spoken response.
Auditory apprehension supplies access to what is voiced.
Disclosure to the knower supplies access beyond the outward answer.

changed_reading.before: The final names are a general doxological close after a power argument.
changed_reading.after: The names make the interrogation answerable under complete audit: spoken allegiance is heard and its actual ground is known.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same worship root is attached to taghut, whose two packet mappings both image a head of deviation and overstepping. Worship in the focus can therefore include outcome-seeking obedience to transgressive authority, not only cultic address.

activation_trace.role: Obedient submission anchors the expanded sense of worship in the focus.
The repeated worship root places obedient submission directly in relation to taghut.
The ط غ ي mapping names taghut as a head of misguidance, identifying the authority receiving submission.
The parallel ط غ و mapping independently preserves taghut as the head of deviation and excess.

structural_cues: 5:60 places عَبَدَ immediately before ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ in one clause.
5:76 repeats ع ب د as an interrogation addressed to plural agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition plus taghut as overstepping leadership; I infer that allegiance is given in hope of managed outcomes. A live alternative restricts ع ب د here to cultic worship.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is asked only about ritual devotion to an inert rival deity.
changed_reading.after: The addressee is also asked why obedient allegiance is yielded to an overstepping authority that cannot guarantee either feared or desired outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The profession 'we believe' and what is concealed are placed under divine knowledge. This sharpens the focus's hearing-knowing pair into an exterior-interior audit: voiced allegiance is heard and its hidden contradiction is known.

activation_trace.role: Hearing supplies reception of the outward profession and answer.
Knowing supplies disclosure of the reality behind speech.
Uttered saying supplies the audible profession of belief.
Hiding and covering supply the concealed counter-layer behind the profession.
Divine knowing explicitly penetrates what the speakers conceal.

structural_cues: 5:61 joins قَالُوا آمَنَّا to يَكْتُمُونَ and says God knows the latter.
5:76 closes an imperative to speak with hearing followed by knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward saying, concealment, and divine knowledge; I assign hearing to the expressed layer and knowing to both layers. The names may alternatively be a non-partitioned pair of general attributes.

changed_reading.before: Hearing and knowing merely amplify divine omniscience.
changed_reading.after: They expose the possible split between a spoken answer to the worship question and the concealed allegiance that the answer masks.

context_deltas.mechanism: Boundness is reversed by extension and expenditure, then upright maintenance is linked to eating from above and below. True sovereignty is rendered as an unblocked capacity that circulates provision, while the focus rival cannot own even the benefit it is expected to deliver.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty supplies the governing capacity whose operation the context displays.
Benefit supplies the favorable outcome later materialized as provision.
A fetter around the limb supplies the denied image of blocked divine capacity.
Breadth, increase, and bounty reverse constriction and supply open capacity.
The going out of wealth in expenditure turns capacity into distributed provision.
Uprightness and balanced standing supply the maintained order linked to provision.
An edible share and provision supplies the concrete benefit arriving from above and below.

structural_cues: 5:64 explicitly reverses a fettered hand with two outspread hands and expenditure.
5:66 makes eating from above and beneath follow the establishment of what was sent down.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies constriction, extension, expenditure, uprightness, and food; I infer a flow from sovereign capacity through maintained order into provision. The two ayat may alternatively offer separate metaphors without one causal system.

changed_reading.before: Owning benefit is static possession of a favorable result.
changed_reading.after: Owning benefit includes the ability to keep provision open, ordered, and circulating rather than merely holding a stock.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated human blindness and deafness are set against divine seeing, then the focus names divine hearing and knowing. The worship error becomes a reversal of receptivity: impaired agents keep choosing deficient recipients while divine perception remains complete.

activation_trace.role: Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the receptive faculty missing from the human sequence.
Knowledge supplies complete apprehension rather than self-obscuring perception.
Blindness of heart and insight supplies the repeated failure to recognize consequences.
Loss of hearing and refusal to listen supplies failed reception.
Divine sight closes the repeated blindness-deafness sequence with unfailed perception.

structural_cues: 5:71 repeats عَمُوا وَصَمُّوا on both sides of repentance.
5:71 closes with divine sight, while 5:76 closes with divine hearing and knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a human sensory failure and contrasting divine faculties; I infer that failed receptivity helps reproduce false allegiance. A live alternative treats 5:71 as a local moral history unrelated to the focus's final names.

changed_reading.before: The focus identifies only a defective object of worship.
changed_reading.after: It also diagnoses a defective reception loop in the worshiper: repeated refusal to hear and perceive permits allegiance to what lacks outcome control.

context_deltas.mechanism: Messenger status, predecessors passing away, and the eating of food form an embodied dependency test. One who receives sustenance and belongs to a passing messenger sequence is a beneficiary within the system, not the sovereign source that owns harm and benefit.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and disposal anchor the contrast between a dependent recipient and the governing source.
Benefit anchors the sustenance that the embodied figures themselves receive.
Messenger and message locate the named figure within transmission rather than at the source of sovereignty.
Passing time and departed generations supply mortality and succession within the messenger class.
Taking food supplies the bodily act of receiving needed material.
Food as livelihood and good condition makes the received benefit explicit.

structural_cues: 5:75 immediately precedes the focus and emphasizes that both named figures ate food.
5:75 places eating beside messenger succession; 5:76 then asks about ownership of harm and benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies messenger status, passing predecessors, and food intake; I infer dependence on provision and vulnerability to succession, which exclude sovereign outcome ownership. Eating may alternatively function only as a concise sign of humanity.

changed_reading.before: The no-harm/no-benefit claim is an abstract denial of power.
changed_reading.after: It is also an embodied dependency test: a recipient who must take in benefit cannot be promoted into the source that owns the outcome system.

context_deltas.mechanism: The deficient nearness of duna and the road-leveling image in worship become a trajectory when following and loyalty attach to desire, producing repeated loss of the extended path. False worship is maintained by a route-making practice, not a single mistaken classification.

activation_trace.role: A near or lower position short of the goal anchors the deficient destination.
A leveled, traveled road supplies the exploratory image of devotion making a repeated route.
Loyal following and succession supply the mechanism that keeps agents on the inherited route.
The inclination of desire supplies the directional pull behind following.
Repeated deviation from guidance and aim supplies accumulated route drift.
An extended path that is traveled supplies the missed governing course.

structural_cues: The branchless root غ ل و at 5:77 word 5 names excess immediately after the focus.
5:77 repeats ض ل ل three times before ending with the path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies excess, following, desire, repeated deviation, and a path; I infer desire-driven over-elevation as the arrow leading to a deficient intermediary. These may alternatively be adjacent admonitions without one route mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Worship beyond God is a static error about an object's rank.
changed_reading.after: It is a practiced trajectory: desire and loyal imitation repeatedly smooth a path toward something near enough to attract but too low to govern outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The failure to restrain reprehensible action presupposes meaningful human intervention and causal responsibility. Thus the focus's denial is best carried as denial of sovereign ownership and guaranteed disposal over outcomes, not denial that creatures can proximally harm, help, or block harm.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and disposal anchor the stronger, ultimate level of agency being denied.
Inflicting harm on another supplies the proximate interpersonal causation that must remain morally legible.
Restraint and prevention supply the unrealized human capacity to interrupt harmful action.
A reprehensible act that should be repelled supplies the social harm requiring intervention.
The production of an act supplies accountable creaturely causation.

structural_cues: 5:79 condemns a community for not stopping one another's reprehensible acts.
5:76 says the rival does not own harm or benefit for the addressees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accountable action and failed prevention; I distinguish proximate causal participation from sovereign ownership of final outcomes. A live alternative takes the focus's denial as rhetorical absoluteness while preserving the same practical responsibility.

changed_reading.before: No creature has any meaningful capacity to harm or benefit another.
changed_reading.after: Creatures can cause and prevent proximate effects and remain accountable, but they cannot own, guarantee, or sovereignly dispose of the final harm-benefit field.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing becomes understanding, recognition releases an embodied overflow, speech becomes testimony, and recompense returns to the speakers because of what they said. The focus's hearing-knowing close is thus not only surveillance but one end of a responsive circuit that can issue in benefit.

activation_trace.role: Hearing as understanding and response anchors the active rather than merely acoustic sense.
Knowledge anchors complete recognition of the response's truth.
Human hearing that understands and accepts initiates the response sequence.
Recognition by a distinguishing trace converts reception into acknowledged truth.
Easy abundant flow supplies the body's released response to recognition.
Tears and their channel specify the material that overflows.
Voiced saying turns inward recognition into public testimony.
A deed's recompense returning to its agent closes the response circuit as benefit.
The explicit link to what they voiced connects heard testimony to returned recompense.

structural_cues: 5:83 sequences hearing, visible overflow, recognition, and voiced belief.
5:85 explicitly makes recompense follow because of what they said.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence and returning reward; I add the directional chain hearing to recognition to embodied response to testimony to recompense. It may alternatively depict sincerity without defining a general hearing-benefit circuit.

changed_reading.before: The final names only warn that God monitors a false answer.
changed_reading.after: They also open a positive response circuit: receptive hearing can become recognition and truthful speech whose benefit returns to the speaker.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق ل ل mapping for قُلْ rather than its ordinary ق و ل sense. It remains anchored to the exact focus word and its repeated packet occurrence, but downstream prose should present it only as rhetorical kinesics, never as a lexical translation of قُلْ.

activation_trace.role: Carrying and rising supply an image of taking up the capacity challenge and setting it publicly in motion.
The repeated command carries the challenge onward into the next address rather than leaving it as a private inference.

changed_reading.before: The speaker is instructed only to pronounce a question.
changed_reading.after: Imagistically, the speaker is made to bear the criterion upright and carry it across successive public confrontations.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it combines the water-control and water-container images inside focus م ل ك and ن ف ع with later flowing rivers. The exact packet branches keep it anchored, but it should be rendered only as a material analogy for sustaining capacity, not as the lexical meaning of نَفْعًا or a claim that 5:76 is specifically about water.

activation_trace.role: Water by which travelers can command their affairs supplies concrete sustaining control.
The side section of a water skin supplies a bounded carrier of life-supporting benefit.
Unimpeded flow expands carried benefit into an enduring provision channel.
A river cutting the earth with running water supplies the large-scale infrastructure of sustained benefit.

changed_reading.before: Benefit is an abstract favorable effect possessed by a patron.
changed_reading.after: Benefit can be pictured materially as the capacity to carry, release, and maintain a life-sustaining flow, a capacity the proposed recipient lacks.

strongest_changes: The immediately preceding food scene turns the abstract power denial into an embodied dependency test.
The failure of mutual restraint in 5:79 forces a distinction between proximate creaturely causation and sovereign ownership of outcomes.
The 5:83-85 sequence turns hearing and knowing from static surveillance into a reception, recognition, testimony, and recompense circuit.
The taghut occurrence expands worship from cultic address to obedient allegiance offered to overstepping authority.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly converts the focus's compact harm-benefit test into mechanisms: metabolic dependence, circulating provision, social intervention, sensory reception, and desire-driven path formation. The closing divine names then govern both concealed allegiance and truthful response.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact extent to which the hearing-knowing order intentionally partitions spoken and concealed layers remains uncertain.
The path model depends on carrying branch imagery across د و ن, ع ب د, and 5:77 rather than on syntax alone.
The ق ل ل and hydraulic readings are deliberately contained branch activations and should not control a conservative synthesis.
The boundary between denied independent ownership and permitted proximate efficacy is conceptually strong but supplied by reader inference.
